title: Binance Will List Flux (FLUX)
text: Fellow Binancians, Binance will list  Flux (FLUX)  and will open trading for  FLUX/BTC ,  FLUX/BUSD , and  FLUX/USDT  trading pairs at 2021-12-10 06:00 (UTC). Users can now start depositing  FLUX  in preparation for trading Withdrawals for FLUX will open at 2021-12-11 06:00 (UTC) Note: Binance will only support FLUX BEP-20 and ERC-20 token deposits and withdrawals The withdrawal open time is an estimated time for users’ reference. Users can view the actual status on the withdrawal page What is Flux (FLUX)? Flux is a decentralized cloud computing network on the Flux blockchain, which utilizes Proof-of-work (PoW) consensus. FLUX is the native utility and governance token of Flux and can be used for network governance, received as rewards for mining, and to pay for network fees. FLUX Listing Fee: 0 BNB.
